name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the commanded pickup. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) is the 'until the door has been opened once' ban: key_lost (dropping the key with the door closed) may not occur before the first door_open, and the ban lifts after that. Both clauses are hard, match the task wording, and add no redundant or unstated requirement.

texts: Eventually pick up the box in the other room, which is the mission's target box.
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: a key_lost event (dropping the key with the door closed) must not happen before the door has been opened.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3

REJECTING_STATES: u2

(u0, !door_open&!key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u1

(u0, !door_open&key_lost&target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u3
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u3, target_picked_up) -> u1
